title: Fix: on iPhones a crate's price tag kept the old price while pricing
problem: Owner's report: on iOS the price tag does not change when the player amends the price. The crate's tags are drawn with a CSS filter (their ink edge); Safari keeps the drawn picture of a filtered element and did not repaint it when only the price text inside changed.
scope: Key each crate tag by what it shows (fruit, price, face up or down, tie, stamp), so a new price makes a new element that Safari draws
A test that every list of tags carries the key

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes, with the new test
Checked on an iPhone: the tag follows the price as it is stepped
acceptance.evidence: No Safari engine in this environment (Chromium only); needs the owner or a player on an iPhone, on the preview.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-15: "theres a bug in the game where ios players price tag doesnt change when they amend the price".

fixed: On iPhones the price tag on your crate now shows the new price as you change it

playerNotes: On iPhones the price tag on your crate now updates as you change the price
